items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: The President of 'Bama State, he liked me very much. If I wanted to go to a show, I'd go up and tell him.

ctx.x: I didn't have to worry too much about that cause I was in school and whatever I needed, I got it there. The President of 'Bama State, he liked me very much. If I wanted to go to a show, I'd go up and tell him. I'd say Pres, I want to go to a movie. Now, he knew what I'd come there for. He used to go in his pocket and give me $2.00 so I could have my chance to go to the show and come back. You know? So, that's all I needed. You know, I was there on the campus. Cause in both schools, high school and 'Bama State…
Hawkins. How old was I? I must have been about 12, 14 years old. I was the captain of the team. You know? So, I used to get along with the students and the teachers, the faculty, and the president.
